## API de Wan 2.7 Enhanced {#wan-2-7-enhanced-api}

Wan 2.7 Enhanced es un modelo de texto a video e imagen a video de Alibaba Qwen, disponible en la Venice API como `wan-2-7-enhanced-text-to-video`. Las solicitudes se anonimizan, por lo que el proveedor nunca ve tu identidad.

### Precios de la API de Wan 2.7 Enhanced {#wan-2-7-enhanced-api-pricing}

| ID del modelo | Variante | Privacidad | Precio |
|---|---|---|---|
| `wan-2-7-enhanced-text-to-video` | Texto a video | Anonymized | desde $0.1287 / s |
| `wan-2-7-enhanced-image-to-video` | Imagen a video | Anonymized | desde $0.1287 / s |

Precios por clip para `wan-2-7-enhanced-text-to-video` con audio:

| Duración | 720p | 1080p |
|---|---|---|
| 5s | $0.64 | $0.99 |
| 10s | $1.29 | $1.98 |
| 15s | $1.93 | $2.97 |

### Cómo usar la API de Wan 2.7 Enhanced {#how-to-use-the-wan-2-7-enhanced-api}

Envía solicitudes a `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue` con `"model": "wan-2-7-enhanced-text-to-video"` y tu clave de API.

```bash
# 1. Queue the job (returns a queue_id)
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "wan-2-7-enhanced-text-to-video",
    "prompt": "Slow aerial drone shot over a misty mountain valley at golden hour",
    "duration": "5s",
    "resolution": "720p",
    "aspect_ratio": "16:9"
  }'

# 2. Poll until the MP4 is ready
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/retrieve \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "model": "wan-2-7-enhanced-text-to-video", "queue_id": "<queue_id>" }' --output video.mp4
```
